hypothesis: At the four-cell stage, embryos whose blastomeres are in full contact at the pole show a polar furrow (a short contact between one pair of opposite cells) and do not meet four-at-a-point in a stable cross.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered (supports). From embryo counts scored by the source as polar furrow or as a four-way junction (X-furrow / simple cross), with a central opening or gap treated as not in full contact and excluded from the denominator: n_in_scope >= 20, the polar-furrow fraction >= 0.90, and the X-furrow fraction <= 0.10. If two or more species each have n >= 10 and at least one of those species meets the refute thresholds below while another meets these support thresholds, the verdict is mixed even if the pooled counts support.
fail_criterion: Pre-registered (refutes). n_in_scope >= 20 and the X-furrow fraction >= 0.25. If n_in_scope >= 20 but neither the support rule nor the refute rule holds, the verdict is mixed. If a scoring table is found but n_in_scope < 20, the verdict is inconclusive with reason underpowered. If the public text does not yield machine-readable counts of polar furrows and four-way junctions, the verdict is inconclusive with reason data-unavailable. Figures are not scored by eye.

test_contract.expected_observation: Among four-cell embryos in full contact at the pole, a polar furrow is present in at least 90 percent and a four-way cross in at most 10 percent.
test_contract.disconfirming_observation: At least 25 percent of full-contact four-cell embryos meet in a four-way cross.
test_contract.admissible_datasets: A public count, from embryos rather than from a simulation, of four-cell stages scored for a polar furrow versus a four-way junction, in animals whose blastomeres can sit in one plane in fluid contact. Embryos the source describes as having a persistent central opening are outside the claim's full-contact scope and do not enter the denominator. Login-walled image stacks are not used.
test_contract.inference_method: Pooled fraction of polar furrows and of four-way junctions among full-contact embryos, with the thresholds in pass_criterion and fail_criterion, plus a per-species split that forces mixed when species with n >= 10 disagree across those thresholds.

interpretation: Thompson's claim is about the four-celled stage of a segmenting egg whose cells are in full fluid contact: the four cells cannot meet in one point, a short intermediate partition (the polar furrow) must be present, and drawings of a simple cross are error or imperfect observation. He allows the furrow to be very short. A central hole, where the four cells do not touch, is not full contact and is not counted as a counterexample. The claim is universal across such eggs; one phoronid study can refute it if four-way junctions are common, and can support it only for the animals actually scored. Tetrahedral four-cell packings that are not a planar junction at the pole are outside the planar cross he discusses and are not recoded.
planned_method: Download the PDF of Pennerstorfer 2015 (DOI 10.18452/17282, bitstream https://edoc.hu-berlin.de/server/api/core/bitstreams/1911bb6c-b4d1-4b9b-89ec-2be03e16abfc/content, 57993948 bytes, md5 2c50a890f0cfcf61bd2fc134138ef8c7 from the repository API). Do not commit the PDF. Extract text and parse counts the source already tabulated for the four-cell stage under the labels polar furrow, X-furrow or cross, and opening or gap. The script writes the parsed rows and the fractions. No count is typed in by hand. Thresholds above are not revised after the table is read.
caveats_before_data: Before this file was committed, the edoc item metadata was read (author Markus Pennerstorfer, doctoral thesis, Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, issued 2015-07-28, license CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 DE, DOI 10.18452/17282) and the bitstream size and md5 were read. The PDF bytes were not downloaded.

The abstract states that cleavage was followed in Phoronis pallida, Phoronis muelleri and Phoronis vancouverensis. A search snippet showed that the thesis defines a polar furrow and an X-furrow; the counts themselves were not opened.
CC BY-NC-ND forbids redistributing a modified copy of the thesis. Only counts computed by the script are written under derived/.
